purpose: Writes the app's style files on the developer's machine: the dev save endpoint for `style.tokens.json` and the logo, and the chosen fonts and `fonts.css` copied out of `@fontsource`.
namedChanges: New code, written for EESpeed Round 7 (U4) from the PictureRecords run-7 `vite.config.ts` (studioSave) and `scripts/exportFonts.mjs`; plain ES modules (.mjs) with a hand-written `src/index.d.mts`, because a bin and a Vite config must run it under Node, which does not run TypeScript from node_modules;

added over the original: the PNG signature check on the logo, 413 for a body over the limit, 405 with Allow, atomic writes, the safe-name rule for a family, and a marker file so only folders this tool made are ever removed;

style-runtime is a peer for types only (`import type`); the check `scripts/check-host-agnostic.mjs` allows node:fs, node:fs/promises, node:path, node:url, node:module, node:http and `import type` from the style-runtime package.

library.title: App style files (dev save endpoint and font export, Node)
library.note: Node only: the Vite dev middleware that writes style.tokens.json and brand-logo.png from the Studio's save, and the command and function that copy the chosen @fontsource woff2 files into public/fonts and write fonts.css. For the screen that chooses the style take style-studio; to apply it in the page take style-runtime.
